component-metadata.author: knimeuser
component-metadata.description:
Metanode generates a static UpSet plot from selected columns of the input table.
UpSet plot is a tool for the visualization of dataset intersection. In contrast to Venn diagrams, UpSet plot allows displaying the intersections also for more than 6 datasets.
During the metanode processing a binary matrix based on the user provided threshold and operator is computed. There is also a possility of setting a lower threshold which the rowsums will be compared to and then based on passing the threshold the particular rows will be filtered out.
The vertical columns in a graph represent number of intersections, horizontal columns represent the size of particular dataset. The cells provide an information whether the particular dataset is a part of intersection (black color) or not (light grey color).
Further details about the UpSet technique can be found here: https://caleydo.org/tools/upset/
